purpose: Independent reference semantics that any batch or cached transform path must match exactly.

checks.name: Product composition matches an independently written composition
Repeated calls are stable, so a frame-scoped cache can be compared against them
A parent edit is visible on the next call (the property a global cache would break)
Reparenting changes the composed result and matches the oracle
The batch solver matches per-call results for every entity in a chain
The batch solver matches per-call results on a long chain and on a subset
A cyclic parent chain terminates and stays finite in both paths
Valid hierarchies still agree exactly, so the divergence is confined to invalid input
A missing parent falls back to the local transform in both paths
